topic_zh: 泛型：一份代码，多种类型
topic_en: Rust generics: one function, many types

xhs.title: 同一个函数，每种类型都抄一遍？
xhs.body:
第 16 课：泛型
函数名后加 <T>，T 是类型参数，调用时编译器自己推出 T 是谁
T 什么都可能是，想比大小要加约束：T: PartialOrd（上期的 trait 派上用场）
编译时每种用到的类型各生成一份，运行时没有额外开销
Option<T>、Vec<T> 都是泛型，自己的 struct 也能写成 Point<T>
考考你：fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一分钟搞懂 Rust 泛型：一份代码，多种类型
douyin.body:
<T> 声明类型参数，trait 约束规定 T 能做什么，编译时展开、没有额外开销。
考考你：fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Stop copying the same function for every type. Rust generics in one minute. Quick quiz: fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); }  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Write it once, use it for every type
linkedin.body:
In Rust, <T> after a function name declares a type parameter; the compiler infers T at each call.
T could be anything, so to compare values you add a trait bound: T: PartialOrd.
At compile time Rust generates a copy for each type you use, so generics add no runtime cost.
You've already used them: Option<T>, Vec<T>, and your own Point<T>.
Quick quiz: fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); }  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); } 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: fn show<T>(x: T) { println!("{}", x); }  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。T 没有约束，编译器不知道 T 能不能打印（error[E0277]）。改成 fn show<T: std::fmt::Display>(x: T) 就行。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. T has no bound, so the compiler can't know it can be printed (error E0277). Write fn show<T: std::fmt::Display>(x: T) and it works.
